Applicants must hold a Chartered Accountant or Cost and Management Accountant qualification with 18 years experience in finance, recovery, accounts, costing, taxation, risk assessment, audit, resource management, project evaluation, financing, and monitoring. content_sections.heading: NCDC Financial Advisor at a Glance

rows.details: CTC based, negotiable as per market standards
Chartered Accountant / Cost and Management Accountant with 18 years experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed proforma along with self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, category certificates (if applicable), and self-attested copies of pay slips. Applications must be sent through registered post, courier, or by hand to the following address: Director (P&A),National Cooperative Development Corporation,4, Siri Institutional Area, Hauz Khas,New Delhi – 110016 Candidates employed in Central/State Governments, Statutory Bodies, or Public Sector Undertakings must send their applications through proper channel along with an Integrity Certificate and No Objection Certificate.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost and Management Accountant (CMA). 18 years of experience in finance, recovery, accounts, costing, taxation, risk assessment, audit, resource management, project evaluation, financing, monitoring, and related functions. At least 5 years of experience must be at Level-13 of the Pay Matrix (according to the 7th CPC) or an equivalent post. Candidates currently working in the private sector must have a CTC comparable to the designated pay scale of candidates working in government or public sector undertakings (PSUs). Holder of CFA, FRM, PRM, or CS qualifications. Experience in cooperative banking will be given preference. 52 years as of 31 August 2026. Age relaxation for physically disabled persons, ex-servicemen, and NCDC regular employees applies as per Government of India norms.

rows.pay_scale_remuneration: CTC-based, market standards, negotiable with no upper limit based on previous or current CTC. Dearness allowance, HRA, transport allowance, contributory pension, gratuity, group insurance, medical reimbursement, and LTC apply as per corporation rules.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay an application fee of Rs. 1200/- online. Payment Details: Online transfer via NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, or UPI to ICICI Bank, Green Park Extension, New Delhi – 110016 branch. Beneficiary Name: National Cooperative Development Corporation, Account Number: 007105003851, IFSC: ICIC0000071. Payment remark must contain the candidate's name and applied post.

rows.category: SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwD (at least 40% disability) / Departmental Regular Employees

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of mark sheets and degree certificates for 10th, 12th, graduation, post-graduation, and other qualifications. Self-attested experience certificates and pay slips. SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen certificate in the prescribed format, if applicable. No Objection Certificate from current employer (for government, PSU, or statutory body employees). Online payment screenshot or self-attested receipt showing UTR/reference number. Original documents for verification during the selection stage.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection comprises shortlisting followed by skill test, written test, oral test, or interview. If applications are high, NCDC may shortlist candidates based on desirable qualifications/experience, higher educational qualifications, relevant experience beyond minimum requirements, calculation of pre/post-qualification experience, or by conducting a recruitment test. Normally, final merit determination carries a 75:25 ratio between recruitment test marks and interview marks.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Financial Advisor post permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The appointment is regular on a fixed tenure of 5 years or up to 60 years of age, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwD, and NCDC departmental regular employees are exempted from paying the application fee of Rs. 1200/-.

faq.question: Q3. How will NCDC shortlist candidates if there are too many applicants?
faq.answer: NCDC may shortlist candidates based on desirable qualifications and experience, higher qualifications, extra relevant experience, or by holding a recruitment test.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who previously applied under advertisement dated 15 July 2026 apply again?
faq.answer: No, candidates who already submitted applications in response to advertisement number 06/2026 dated 15.07.2026 do not need to apply again; their earlier submissions will be considered under the revised criteria.
